$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the tier step carries continue-on-error. The exit of tea-evaluate is the verdict, so a step that cannot fail the job turns every blocking class into a pass.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean and every element is present, but the step that invokes tea-evaluate carries continue-on-error: true, which the rule that a gate must be able to fail forbids, so the result carries one rule violation.

ruleViolations: continue-on-error: on a step that runs an evaluation check in job evaluation-pr step 5
